description: One extra segment for a MAD REPEATER envelope; it goes immediately to the right of a MAD REPEATER, or of another F that is itself in that chain

params.text: Sets the voltage this segment arrives at, 0V to 10V; it sets off from wherever the segment before it finished
Bends this segment between its two voltages: a straight line in the middle, clockwise for a slow start and fast finish, anticlockwise for a fast start and slow finish
Sets how long this segment takes, 1ms to 10 seconds with a tenfold change every quarter turn; with SYNC on it reads as a fraction or multiple of a beat, from a sixteenth to sixteen
Takes this segment's length from the clock at the MAD REPEATER's TRIGGER jack rather than from the DURATION knob's seconds

outputs.text: A 1ms trigger at 10V at the moment this segment begins
The envelope while this segment is running, and this segment's LEVEL voltage the rest of the time

notes: nothing here runs on its own. The whole envelope is computed by the MAD REPEATER to the left, which also writes this module's two output jacks.
with no MAD REPEATER to the left through an unbroken run of F modules, the envelope jack holds the LEVEL voltage and the trigger jack stays at 0V.
the SYNC switch here reads the clock patched into the MAD REPEATER's TRIGGER jack, and the pulses per beat are set on the MAD REPEATER's menu.
